project_title: VILLAGE HOMESTAY — Terracotta & Sand (Award-Worthy Landing Page)

context.theme: Organic & Earthy Luxury Village Architectural Homestay
context.mood: Tactile, warm, cinematic, editorial, deeply rooted in nature and raw craftsmanship
context.target_audience: Discerning urban travelers, nature lovers, architects, slow-travel enthusiasts, family retreats seeking raw clay luxury

headings.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
headings.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-[1.15]

mono_accent.usage: Dates, pricing tags, room specs, availability codes, coordinates, badge labels

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard with generous margins: py-20, py-28, px-6, px-12, gap-8, gap-12

grid_strategy.hero: Asymmetric split grid with focal photography clipped in terracotta curved frames and animated doodle vector overlay
grid_strategy.bento_architecture: MODE A Tetris grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12) for showing Mangalore tiles, clay jaali work, bamboo verandah, paddy pond
grid_strategy.rooms_carousel: Card grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3) with embedded live availability calendar preview
grid_strategy.tabs_section: Dual-tab interactive console for Booking & Enquiry with live price calculator and room date picker

design_features.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FCF9F2]/80 border-b border-[#E2D3C1]) with logo, section links, and direct CTA 'Reserve Stay'
design_features.doodle_motifs: Custom SVG village doodle line-art overlays (paddy stalks, lantern flame, traditional pottery wheel, village house line outline) drawn in terracotta strokes
interactivity: Room Availability Calendar per room (Interactive state showing Free vs Booked dates with quick selection)
Tabbed Booking vs. General Enquiry forms with real-time field validation, date selectors, guest counter, and instant summary sheet
Interactive Village Map / Experiences slider (Paddy walks, Pottery making, Clay-pot dining, Lantern night stargazing)
Motion entrance effects using Framer Motion with smooth stagger and lenis scroll

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All clickable buttons, inputs, tabs, modal controls, calendar dates, and key content blocks must feature data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript files (.js, .jsx) only, not TypeScript (.tsx).
Load Cormorant Garamond and Plus Jakarta Sans in index.html or top of index.css.
Do NOT use pure transparent headers. Use semi-opaque tinted glass with backdrop blur.
Do NOT use generic blue or purple gradients. Stick strictly to Terracotta (#C05621), Sand (#F5EBE1), Lime Wash (#FCF9F2), and Earth Charcoal (#231F1D).
Ensure every form field and button has explicit hover, active, and focus styles with appropriate contrast.
Make sure room availability calendar is interactive and clearly distinguishes between available and booked days.
Ensure FastAPI backend endpoints are connected for submitting bookings and enquiries smoothly.
